title: Courtyard House
brief: A contemporary family residence organized around water, daylight, and a quiet internal garden.
overview: The house is conceived as a sequence of shaded rooms gathered around a planted courtyard. Long views across the center bring daylight deep into the plan while preserving privacy from the street.

Natural stone, warm timber, and softly textured plaster establish a restrained material language. Each space is precise in proportion but relaxed in use, allowing the home to shift easily between intimate family life and larger gatherings.
